title: Rs Estimator
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset/Parameter Estimation/PMSM Parameter Estimation/Rs_Estimator.md
Motor Control Blockset/Parameter Estimation/ACIM Parameter Estimation/Rs_Estimator.md
text: Estimate stator resistance ( R s ) of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Maximum current limit (A)} sets the maximum allowed current during testing, {Step size during injected voltage ramp up (per-unit)}, {Maximum voltage ramp up time limit (s)} sets the maximum voltage ramp up duration, {Number of voltage and current samples per voltage injection instance} sets the number of voltage and current samples considered for Rs, {Dwell time between voltage injections (s)} sets the wait duration between voltage injections and {Threshold to determine imbalance in phase resistances (0,1)} sets the threshold to determine phase resistance. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: StartStop
ports.summary: Control signal for R s estimation logical

ports.name: Vabc
ports.summary: a, b, and c -axis stator reference voltage components vector

params.name: Maximum current limit (A)
params.values: Maximum allowed current during testing 15 (default) | scalar

params.name: Step size during injected voltage ramp up (per-unit)
params.values: Step size during injected voltage ramp up 0.0001 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum voltage ramp up time limit (s)
params.values: Maximum voltage ramp up duration 0.25 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of voltage and current samples per voltage injection instance
params.values: Number of voltage and current samples considered for Rs estimation 1000 (default) | scalar

params.name: Dwell time between voltage injections (s)
params.values: Wait duration between voltage injections 0.25 (default) | scalar

params.name: Threshold to determine imbalance in phase resistances (0,1)
params.values: Threshold to determine phase resistance imbalance 0.2 (default) | scalar
